content.title: Gold and Silver Are Finishing a Record-Setting Year With…More Records
content.summary: 1722 ET – Gold and silver rose to new records on Friday, which is what they’ve been doing for much of 2025. The precious metal’s price has surged 66% this year to $4,387.30 a troy ounce.
